title: [tool_crash] Unhandled ProcessPackageException (OS Error 206: The filename or extension is too long) in _DefaultPub._preloadPubCache
body:
## Summary
`flutter pub get` crashes on Windows with an unhandled `ProcessPackageException` (`ProcessException: The filename or extension is too long`, OS error code `206` / `ERROR_FILENAME_EXCED_RANGE`) in `_DefaultPub._preloadPubCache` (`package:flutter_tools/src/dart/pub.dart:645`) / `ErrorHandlingProcessManager.runSync` (`package:flutter_tools/src/base/error_handling_io.dart:1310`).

## Crash Telemetry (Flutter `stable/3.47.7`)
* **Signature**: `ProcessPackageException at LocalProcessManager.runSync at package:process/src/interface/local_process_manager.dart-313da74f`
* **Rank**: #10 Top Crasher in `3.47.7`
* **Total Occurrences**: 19 (3.7% of Top 10, 1.9% of all `3.47.7` crashes, ~2.5 crashes/day)
* **Platform Distribution**: Windows: 19 (100.0%)
* **Sample Command**: `flutter pub get`
* **Error**:
```text
ProcessException: The filename or extension is too long (at ../../runtime/bin/process_win.cc:579) | Command: C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\d--Dotlinker-Laravel-New-Set...
```

## Stack Trace
```text
#0      LocalProcessManager.runSync (package:process/src/interface/local_process_manager.dart:118)
#1      ErrorHandlingProcessManager.runSync.<anonymous closure> (package:flutter_tools/src/base/error_handling_io.dart:1310)
#2      _runSync (package:flutter_tools/src/base/error_handling_io.dart:1118)
#3      ErrorHandlingProcessManager.runSync (package:flutter_tools/src/base/error_handling_io.dart:1308)
#4      _DefaultPub._preloadPubCache (package:flutter_tools/src/dart/pub.dart:645)
#5      _DefaultPub._getPubCacheIfAvailable (package:flutter_tools/src/dart/pub.dart:624)
#6      _DefaultPub._createPubEnvironment (package:flutter_tools/src/dart/pub.dart:664)
#7      _DefaultPub._runWithStdioInherited (package:flutter_tools/src/dart/pub.dart:379)
```

## Root Cause
1. In `_DefaultPub._preloadPubCache` (`package:flutter_tools/src/dart/pub.dart`), `flutter_tools` passes all `.tar.gz` archive paths in `$FLUTTER_ROOT/.pub-preload-cache` to a single `_processManager.runSync(<String>[..._pubCommand, 'cache', 'preload', ...cacheFiles])` invocation. When the Flutter SDK or current working directory is located in a deep Windows path (or the concatenated `.tar.gz` paths exceed Windows `CreateProcessW` / `MAX_PATH` limits in `runtime/bin/process_win.cc`), Windows fails with error code `206` (`ERROR_FILENAME_EXCED_RANGE`: `The filename or extension is too long`).
2. In `_handleWindowsException` (`package:flutter_tools/src/base/error_handling_io.dart:1467-1522`), error code `206` is not listed in the `switch (errorCode)` statement, so `_onProcessException` returns without throwing a `ToolExit` and `_runSync` rethrows the raw `ProcessPackageException`.

## Recommendation
1. Add `const kFilenameExcedRange = 206;` (`ERROR_FILENAME_EXCED_RANGE`) to `_handleWindowsException` in `package:flutter_tools/src/base/error_handling_io.dart` so process/filesystem calls failing with error code `206` exit cleanly with a `ToolExit` instructing the user to move the project/SDK to a shorter path or enable Windows Long Paths.
2. In `_DefaultPub._preloadPubCache` (`package:flutter_tools/src/dart/pub.dart`), batch `cacheFiles` (or run with `workingDirectory: preloadCacheDir.path` using relative archive filenames) so `dart pub cache preload` does not exceed Windows command-line / path length limits.

references.title: [flutter_tools] Exit cleanly when Windows path exceeds MAX_PATH (OS Error 206)
[flutter_tools] Pass relative archive paths to pub cache preload
